subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence for SDLC controls — AcmeBank intake
messages:
From: SecureAssess <audit@secureassess.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Wright <sam.wright@acmebank.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Nov 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence for SDLC controls — AcmeBank intake

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for agreeing to field AcmeBank's SOC 2 assessor request. They have a fairly focused intake asking for evidence that matches controls around secure SDLC: code review enforcement, CI/CD gating and logs, secrets management (ephemeral creds/KMS usage), and change management/approval trails.

Can you provide the following by EOD Thursday, Nov 7:
- A control matrix mapping Redwood policies to Acme's SOC 2 control IDs (CSV preferred)
- Representative code review artifacts (redacted PR and signoff trace)
- CI/CD policy and recent enforcement logs (last 12 months) showing PR gating and automated checks
- Evidence of secrets handling / ephemeral credential usage (KMS configs, rotation cadence)
- Change approval log for releases in 2028-2029 showing approver identities and timestamps

If some items will be redacted, please indicate what was removed and why. Also include links to any internal docs or a HubSpot record for the intake. If you need an extension, let me know.

Appreciate the help — this is time-boxed for Acme's auditor. Sam, copying you for visibility.

Regards,
Maya Patel
SecureAssess — Lead Assessor
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Nov 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 evidence for SDLC controls — AcmeBank intake

Team — forwarding assessor intake from SecureAssess (AcmeBank). Quick plan: Jordan, you're the primary for policy mapping and code review artifacts; Irene, please pull a redacted PR and reviewer signoffs for a typical release PR; Mina, need CI logs + KMS/ephemeral creds notes.

Deadline: EOD Thu Nov 7. If you hit blockers (legal redaction, production logs access) call it out today and I'll escalate. Attachments that go back to the assessor should be clearly named and include a short README describing redactions.

Thanks — Lauren
Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Nov 4, 2029 at 09:12 SecureAssess <audit@secureassess.com> wrote:
> (original request quoted)
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Nov 2029 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 evidence for SDLC controls — AcmeBank intake

Thanks Lauren — quick status and ask:

1) Control matrix: I will map Redwood policies to Acme control IDs and produce a CSV (acme_sdlc_control_matrix.csv). Will flag any gaps.

2) Code review artifacts: I will extract a sanitized PR thread (PR-4123) that demonstrates multi-reviewer enforcement and automated checks. It will include reviewer handles, CI status, and final merge timestamp. Expect code-review-sample-PR-4123.txt.

3) CI/CD enforcement: we retain 12 months of pipeline execution logs in GCS and can export a filtered slice showing PR gating (block on failing checks). Mina — can you pull a condensed export and the CI policy doc? I have a draft policy to attach (ci_pipeline_policy_v2.pdf) but need the actual enforcement snippets.

4) Secrets/ephemeral creds: we use Vault for short-lived AWS creds issued by the runner and KMS for long-term key material. Mina, please include a short snippet of the ephemeral credentials config and the KMS rotation schedule. Redact account ids.

5) Change management: we maintain a CSV of release approvals that ties Jira release tickets to approvers. I can author the change-approval-log-2028-2029.csv once Mina pulls the release timestamps.

I'll assemble and sign off before we send to SecureAssess. If any artifact risks exposing customer data, we'll redact and note the redaction.

— Jordan
Security Engineering Manager
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 05 Nov 2029 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 evidence for SDLC controls — AcmeBank intake

AL: pulled the requested exports and prepared the artifacts. Summary below plus attachments (redactions noted).

Attachments included here for internal review:
- ci_pipeline_policy_v2.pdf — our current enforcement policy (no customer data).
- pipeline-enforcement-sample.log (excerpt) — shows block on failing linter/test for PR-4123 (redacted run IDs).
- ephemeral-credentials-config-snippet.txt — small snippet of runner role configuration (AWS account IDs redacted with <REDACTED>).
- kms-rotation-summary.txt — rotation cadence and key alias list (customer aliases redacted).
- change-approval-log-2028-2029.csv — release ticket, approver handle, UTC timestamp (names are internal only; no customer PII).

Notes / caveats:
- Logs: we removed full traces and stack dumps to avoid PII exposure. The pipeline-enforcement-sample.log includes STATUS lines, timestamps, and the gating decision.
- PR artifacts: Irene, I can hand off a sanitized PR thread to include the reviewer emails/handles and CI green/fail markers.
- KMS: we cannot share raw key material; the kms-rotation-summary is high-level and shows rotation frequency and automated alerts.

Next steps: Jordan to combine control matrix + redacted PR; Lauren to review README and signoff. After that I'll bundle and send to SecureAssess.

— Mina
Senior DevOps Engineer
